name: Zhu Rong
title: The Savage Queen

skills.name: Giant Elephant
skills.text: BARBARIANS南蛮入侵 have no effect on you. When any BARBARIANS 南蛮入侵 used by other players is placed into the discard pile after all damage has been resolved, you acquire it.

skills.name: Fearsome Blade
skills.text: Every instance after you inflict damage to your target by using ATTACK杀, you can conduct a Points Duel with that target player. If you win, you acquire a card from that player.

differenceFromNormal: She cannot activate “Fearsome Blade” if she inflicts damage to a player that is not her target. That means she cannot points duel with a player that receives damage by shackling effect, for example.
